contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成尋寶任務(1)！朱銘老師從苗栗通霄的傳統木雕師傅，蛻變成享譽國際的藝術大師，並且創立朱銘美術館，發願種活藝術的種子，畢生貫徹其「藝術即修行」的理念。大笨鳥也很喜歡朱銘老師的作品，偶爾會來練太極喔！讓我們繼續這場冒險探索臺大校園，為保護生態環境貢獻了一份力量，下一個任務等著你！

Congratulations on successfully completing Treasure Hunt Mission (1)! Master Ju Ming transformed from a traditional woodcarving craftsman in Tongxiao, Miaoli, into an internationally renowned art master. He also founded the Ju Ming Museum, dedicating his life to planting the seeds of living art and fully embodying his philosophy that “art is a form of spiritual practice.” The Big dump bird also loves Master Ju Ming’s works and sometimes comes to practice Tai Chi! Let’s continue this adventure exploring the NTU campus and contribute to protecting the ecological environment. The next mission is waiting for you!
